newsitem.title: USA: NOTICE OF SALE - Long Beach, N.J.
newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Long Beach, N.J.

text.p: SEALED PROPOSALS will be received by the undersigned for the Township of Long Beach, County of Ocean, New Jersey (Township'') at Township Municipal Building, 6805 Long Beach Boulevard, Brant Beach, New Jersey, 08008, until 11:00 A.M., on at which time they will be publicly opened and announced for the purchase of the captioned bonds (Bonds''), due on February 1, as follows:
Year Amount Year Amount Year Amount
2002150,000 The Bonds will be dated February 1, 1997 and bear interest at the rate per annum specified by the successful bidder therefor, payable on August 1, 1997 and semiannually

thereafter on February 1 and August 1 in each year until maturity or earlier redemption. The Bonds will be subject to redemption prior to maturity on the terms and conditions set forth in the Preliminary Official Statement hereinafter mentioned. Upon initial issuance, the Bonds will be issued in book- entry-only form and registered in the name of Cede & Co., as nominee of The Depository Trust Company, New York, New York (DTC''). Individual purchases may be made in the principal amount of $5,000 or any integral multiple thereof through book entries made on the books and records of DTC and its participants. The Bonds will be issued subject to the approving legal opinion of Parker, McCay & Criscuolo, Marlton, New Jersey, Bond Counsel. Copies of the full Notice of Sale, Official Form of Proposal and Preliminary Official Statement may be obtained by contacting the undersigned. The Township's telephone number is (609) 361-1000. Dated: January 15, 1997
